B_field_step.tag: EXACT relations (derivation in SCALE.md section 2; symbol and stability from worker X5, work/X5/field_symbol.json); Coulomb check MEASURED here
B_field_step.field_step: F = prod_links exp(-i eps E^2/2) . prod_plaquettes exp(-i kappa (1 - cos B)); pattern of integer link charge q routes with exp(i q theta)
B_field_step.symbol (X5): cos(omega) = 1 - 2 eps kappa sum_i sin^2(k_i/2) per field step; two polarizations; stable for all k iff 3 eps kappa <= 1
B_field_step.speed: c_f = n sqrt(eps kappa) cells per tick for n field steps per tick
B_field_step.static_phase: two unit link charges at distance r: phase eps (G(0) - G(r)) per field step, G -> 1/(4 pi r)
B_field_step.condition_for_the_routing_speed: n^2 eps kappa = 1 with n >= 2 (n = 1 is unstable on 78.7 percent of the zone, X5); then alpha_m = alpha_f = alpha, eps = 4 pi alpha / n, kappa = 1/(4 pi alpha n)
B_field_step.one_number_left_per_link_variable: after the speed condition the pair (eps, kappa) holds exactly one free number, the coupling
B_field_step.several_factors: link exp(i theta^a T_a), Tr_5 T_a T_b = delta/2, kinetic (eps_i/2) sum_a E_a^2, plaquette term 2 kappa_i (d - Re Tr U): at linear order every component has the U(1) symbol; alpha_i = sqrt(eps_i/kappa_i)/(4 pi); with all speeds equal to the routing speed alpha_1 : alpha_2 : alpha_3 = eps_1 : eps_2 : eps_3
B_field_step.trace_form_in_these_variables: eps_1 = eps_2 = eps_3 for trace-normalized generators; for the compact hypercharge phase with integer charge Q6: eps_C = eps_1/60, kappa_C = 60 kappa_1; for the photon phase with integer charge 3Q: alpha_link = alpha_em/9
B_field_step.imported_not_checked: a compact U(1) link has a confining phase at strong coupling (Wilson action: below beta = 1/e^2 of about 1.01); the small-field symbol applies on the weak side
